summary: Iteration 7 — Stripe LIVE payment integration verified end-to-end WITHOUT completing any real card payment. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases GREEN in /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_live.py (LIVE keys). GET /api/billing/stripe/config → {enabled:true, publishableKey:'pk_live_51U6vBrGtsNUI6sgCMQc3grpyYsepTFGGInQOYyccBvc5T1p...', currency:'eur'}. POST /api/billing/stripe/create-checkout works for all 4 plans (basic_monthly, basic_yearly, premium_monthly, premium_yearly) → returns real cs_live_ sessionId + https://checkout.stripe.com/ checkoutUrl. VOD flow works with real showId → cs_live_ session; missing show_id → 400; unknown show_id → 404. Auth boundary VERIFIED: user B gets 404 when fetching user A's session-status. No-auth POST /create-checkout → 401. Return + cancel HTML pages render 200 text/html. Webhook accepts JSON POST (200). Frontend (mobile 390x844, admin OTP dev-returned): Checkout renders 4 method rows in correct order [PayPal, Card (Stripe), MTN Mobile Money, Airtel]. Stripe row sub-text matches spec: 'Live — Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay & Google Pay'. Selecting Stripe → PAY button shows 'PAY 1.00 EUR' + 'Live Stripe. Pay by Visa, Mastercard, Amex, or wallet — you'll be redirected to secure Stripe Checkout' info banner. Tapping PAY calls /billing/stripe/create-checkout, receives cs_live_ session, opens https://checkout.stripe.com/ in a new tab (web) and starts polling /session-status. MoMo failure fallback banner VERIFIED: entering +250788999888 as MoMo phone → BeSoft returns real 'MoMo declined: provider error [HTTP_400]' → banner [data-testid=momo-fallback-stripe] appears with text 'Try card payment instead? Pay with Visa, Mastercard, Amex, Apple Pay, or Google Pay via Stripe.' → tap → Stripe method becomes active, error clears. VOD screen: locked-box renders 3 buttons stacked in correct order: 'PAY 1.00€ (CARD)' [buy-vod-stripe-btn], 'PAY WITH PAYPAL' [buy-vod-btn], '1,000 RWF (MOMO)' [buy-vod-momo-btn]. Tapping CARD → opens Stripe checkout with cs_live_ session, closed without any card entry. iOS gate present at checkout.tsx:13,20,165,375 and video/[id].tsx:47,120,243,291 (Platform.OS==='ios' correctly hides Stripe row/fallback/CARD button on iOS). Deprecated packages / SafeAreaView / other Expo issues: NONE detected. NO REAL CARD WAS ENTERED — all Stripe popups closed immediately after URL verification.

minor.issue: Invalid `plan` value returns 422 (Pydantic Literal validation) instead of the documented 400 (HTTPException at server.py:1532-1533 is unreachable because StripeCheckoutIn.plan is Optional[Literal[...]]). Cosmetic only — same pattern as MoMo initiate flagged in iteration_6. Test accepts both 400/422.

ui_bugs.issue: Locked-box with 3 stacked buttons overlaps/crowds the show metadata (title, description) below on 390x844 viewport. The 'Rwanda Sound Sessions' title + description sits partly behind/next to the last MoMo button. Recommend adding marginBottom to lockedBox OR using absolute positioning so content below has clearance. Non-blocking; buttons still tap correctly. Reference: /app/frontend/app/video/[id].tsx:234-286.

action_items: OPTIONAL POLISH: server.py:1497-1500 — either drop the Literal on StripeCheckoutIn.plan (use `str` + runtime check at 1532-1533 to get a clean 400) OR add a custom exception handler for RequestValidationError to map 422 → 400 for this endpoint. Same cosmetic issue as MoMo iteration_6.

OPTIONAL POLISH: /app/frontend/app/video/[id].tsx locked-box crowds the metadata; add marginBottom (~spacing.lg) so the 3 stacked purchase buttons don't visually overlap the show title/description below.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:1497-1609 stripe_create_checkout is clean: server-side price map (STRIPE_EUR_PRICES) prevents client tampering, mode selected server-side, metadata carries {user_id, purchase_type, plan/show_id}, subscription_data.metadata mirrored, idempotency_key = uuid per request, pending payment doc persisted with stripeSessionId, no _id leaked. Uses `managed_payments: {enabled: False}` to bypass tax-code requirement on this Stripe account (fine).

server.py:1612-1660 _stripe_grant_from_session is idempotent (checks status=='paid'/'complete' before granting), reads user_id from session.metadata (server-set, not client-set), updates user.tier + subscriptionExpiry OR appends showId to unlockedVods, then marks payment.status='paid'. Good pattern.

server.py:1662-1690 session_status endpoint enforces ownership at DB layer (find_one with userId filter → 404 for wrong user) — verified via test. Refetches from Stripe and lazily triggers fulfilment on paid status. Good.

server.py:1692-1740 webhook: enforces signature verification only when STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set (currently empty in .env). Idempotent via db.stripe_events.eventId unique record. ACTION FOR MAIN AGENT: configure STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET in .env before flipping to production so unsigned events are rejected.

frontend/app/checkout.tsx:12-20 METHODS array is data-driven with hiddenOnIOS flag → filtered at module load. Note: this means iOS toggling would require an app reload (Platform.OS is captured once at module import); acceptable because iOS is a build-time decision, not runtime.
frontend/app/checkout.tsx:63-85 pollStripe polls every ~2s up to ~90s using session-status endpoint. On success calls refresh(). Cancels on 'expired'. Reasonable.

frontend/app/checkout.tsx:87-105 onStripeNav + line 231-234 onShouldStartLoadWithRequest correctly return false for /billing/stripe/return and /billing/stripe/cancel URLs so the WebView doesn't try to render the HTML pages inside itself — parent handler receives the completion signal. Matches spec.
frontend/app/video/[id].tsx:71-88 buyVodStripe and :90-107 pollStripe mirror the checkout.tsx pattern for VOD; :243-249 CARD button gated by !isIOS. Consistent.

Corresponding db.payments records exist with status='pending' — safe to leave (do not settle to any charge without a customer action).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_stripe_live.py — uses `xdist_group='stripe_admin_otp_shared'` to keep admin OTP tests on one worker. Regular user phone is +250788999888 (per review request); admin is +250798875272. OTP always returned in `testCode` field for ADMIN_PHONES + dev mode. To retest without triggering LIVE charges, ONLY tap the pay button and close the resulting popup — never enter card details on checkout.stripe.com. If STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET later gets configured, the structural webhook test may return 400 (bad signature) — that's expected; update test_webhook_endpoint_accepts_post to send a signed payload OR skip that assertion.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs. Stripe LIVE integration is functional end-to-end at session-creation and UI-rendering layers, which is the full extent of what can be tested without real cardholder consent. Payment completion + fulfilment (_stripe_grant_from_session) is covered by code review only — cannot be exercised without a real card charge in LIVE mode.
